ucm_acm_faith_refresh_display_lists_effect = {
  if = {
    limit = { has_variable = ucm_selected_faith_var }
    clear_global_variable_list = ucm_acm_fe_display_core_tenets
    clear_global_variable_list = ucm_acm_fe_display_main_group
    clear_global_variable_list = ucm_acm_fe_display_marriage
    clear_global_variable_list = ucm_acm_fe_display_crimes
    clear_global_variable_list = ucm_acm_fe_display_clergy
    var:ucm_selected_faith_var = { main_rite = { save_scope_as = ucm_fe_rite } }
    if = {
      limit = { scope:ucm_fe_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_peace_of_god } }
      add_to_global_variable_list = { name = ucm_acm_fe_display_core_tenets target = flag:tenet_peace_of_god }
    }
    if = {
      limit = { scope:ucm_fe_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_dulia } }
      add_to_global_variable_list = { name = ucm_acm_fe_display_core_tenets target = flag:tenet_dulia }
    }
    if = {
      limit = { scope:ucm_fe_rite = { rite_has_tenet = tenet_transubstantiation } }
      add_to_global_variable_list = { name = ucm_acm_fe_display_core_tenets target = flag:tenet_transubstantiation }
    }
